question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

King Zheng is known to lead an army of a million armoured soldiers, a thousand chariots and ten thousand horses in his misssion to conquer the neighbouring kingdoms.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"misssion"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"mission". (**मिशन)

 
 
• **Example: **He was on a **mission** to find the lost treasure.
 
 
 
• **"Mission"** refers to an important task or duty that a person or group of people is sent somewhere to do. (मिशन)
 
 
• **Example: **The astronauts were on a **mission **to explore Mars.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Chariots** (रथ): A type of ancient two-wheeled vehicle drawn by horses, used in racing and warfare.

 
 
• **Example:** The ancient soldiers rode into battle on chariots.
 
 
 
• **Kingdoms** (राज्य): A country, state, or territory ruled by a king or queen.
 
 
• **Example: **The medieval kingdoms were often at war with each other.
 
 
 
• **Thousand** (हजार): The number equivalent to the product of a hundred and ten.
 
 
• **Example:** The stadium can hold up to fifty thousand people.
